lines: This plan covers 7 days, starting Saturday 2026-09-12.
You cook on Sunday: the plan sets its sessions on those days, and nowhere else.
The plan starts on Saturday, a day earlier: that is the cooking day, and nothing is eaten on it.
Everything is cooked on Saturday, in one go: whatever would not keep in the fridge until the meal goes in the freezer.
One shop, on Saturday: everything this plan asks for keeps until it is cooked.
The Saturday session will take 3 hours 30 min rather than 2 hours: it is your only cooking day, and cooking less would leave days empty.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.
The single Saturday session runs longer than the usual evening allowance because the freezer is what makes the requested six-day stretch executable without another cooking day.
Fresh herbs and salad leaves were limited to early meals, while later meals use sturdier vegetables and frozen portions because there is no later shop.
Breakfasts are assembled or cooked fresh rather than batch-cooked, giving the repeated lunch and dinner preparations more variety while keeping all three daily meals protein-centred.
